comment: City-realism batch: one shot per phase with the realism options at their defaults. Run on RWG2_CONTINENTS seed 4242 (default profile) for the shots that do not start with net-, on classic RWG seed 777 (default profile) for a second view of them, and the net- shots with the rarecities profile, which is the one that places cities on the jittered grid and links them (lc-remote.sh shots ... -- --jvm '-Dlostcitiesnh.dimensionProfiles=0=rarecities' --only net-...).
title: City-realism batch

shots.name: pitch-interior
shots.caption: Phase 1, 8-high floors (floorPitch 8, D289, D295): a ground-floor room of the building nearest the spawn; the ceiling stands 8 blocks above the floor, so a player is not cramped.

shots.name: pitch-street
shots.caption: Phase 1, 8-high floors (D289): a primary street between buildings whose floors and windows follow the 8-block pitch; city levels (streets, highways) stay 6 high.

shots.name: rings-above
shots.caption: Phase 2, density rings (D306): the city nearest the spawn from south of its center, tall towers in the inner ring, lower buildings and parks outward.

shots.name: rings-taper
shots.caption: Phase 2, core taper (D219, D306, D307): the skyline from outside the city, a high-rise core falling to low buildings and lots at the edge.

shots.name: lots-footprint
shots.caption: Phase 3, lot footprints (D325): an edge lot, an excavation or foundation at its real size (more than one chunk where the lot covers several), with the intensity of its chunk.

shots.name: district-yard
shots.caption: Phase 5c, districts (D350): an industrial yard (a plaza only where no yard is in reach) seen from a corner above, against the buildings around it.

shots.name: district-plaza
shots.caption: Phase 5c, districts (D350): the paved central plaza at the city's center, seen close from above and south, with the park belt and towers farther out.

shots.name: rooms-interior
shots.caption: Phase 6, room rules (roomRules, D353): the ground floor of the building nearest the spawn, a shop or kitchen room by the building table, with loot and spawners kept to rooms that fit.

shots.name: furnished-room
shots.caption: Phase 6, furnished interiors (D330, 0016): a residential or office floor furnished with several wall-side pieces, every room kept in one piece. Plain blocks first, few tile entities.

shots.name: gt-room
shots.caption: Phase 6, GT machines and partial multiblocks (D339, D362): an industrial floor (workshop, oil rig, radio tower), else a cellar workshop, with low-tier GT machines and loose multiblock controllers.

shots.name: packhouse
shots.caption: Phase 6/edges, pack houses (D297, D369): an empty edge lot with a house built by another pack mod's own generator, seen from the street its door faces.

shots.name: door-steps
shots.caption: Walkable door steps (D376): street level looking across the street at building doors, which open onto steps up to the floor.

shots.name: net-overview
shots.caption: Phase 4, jittered network (D270, D310, D320; rarecities profile): the city nearest the spawn from 160 blocks up, links leaving it to its 3 nearest cities.

shots.name: net-highway
shots.caption: Phase 4, link network (D310, D311; rarecities): a straight highway piece of a city-to-city link with highway ahead, from 15 blocks above the deck.

shots.name: net-ramp
shots.caption: Phase 4, link network (D316, D319; rarecities): where a link climbs or falls to a city, seen from above the ramp's edge.

shots.name: net-station
shots.caption: Phase 4, rail on links (D321; rarecities): the station nearest the spawn on a link between two cities.

shots.name: net-beltway
shots.caption: Phase 5, beltway (D340, D343, D346; rarecities): a straight piece of a city's ring highway, seen along the ring from 15 blocks above its deck; towers stay inside the ring.

shots.name: net-beltway-above
shots.caption: Phase 5, beltway (D340, D343; rarecities): the same ring from 70 blocks up, looking along it at the city inside and the interchanges where links meet it.

shots.name: net-diagonal
shots.caption: Phase 4, diagonal routes (D311, D316; rarecities): the same link from 100 blocks above the ramp's middle, where its 45-degree run shows against the grid of streets.
